messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "watery or has blood in it"
set: ["watery or has blood in it", "do not use if medicine looks cloudy, has changed colors, or has particles in it", "call your pharmacist if the medicine looks cloudy has changed colors or has particles in it", "discard the pen if it has been frozen", "stop taking if diarrhea is watery or bloody", "this practice has resulted in death", "has its own separate doses because it is absorbed differently", "decrease dose if protein or blood in urine", "place it in a puncture-proof sharps container and dispose of it following state or local laws", "call doctor if watery stools or stomach pain not going away", "report urinating less than usual or blood in urine", "clean it and let it dry", "replace your inhaler if it is washed or placed in water", "call your doctor at once if you have watery or bloody diarrhea", "make liquid before taking or giving it", "tell doctor if blood in urine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
